digest.component_or_area: pytest test fixtures / subprocess environment handling
propositions: Seven pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) copies that leak arbitrary inherited secrets when pytest renders fixture arguments during long traceback failures.
Default long traceback output with saferepr renders ambient credentials present in fixture-returned environment mappings, while short traceback does not.
Minimal-environment test runs with only explicit allowlisted variables and fake-bin-first PATH pass all affected fixture consumers, proving arbitrary ambient keys are not required.
Each of the seven fixtures must replace broad os.environ copies with explicit mutable allowlists containing only required variables (PATH, STATE_DIR, HEALTH_TIMEOUT, etc.) and per-test overrides.
Security oracle tests with synthetic sentinels confirm the leak reproduces on all seven real fixture surfaces and validates absence after allowlist fixes.
